provenance: Author-created fictional company policies; no real customers or confidential documents.

documents.text: Orion refunds are available within 30 days of purchase. Refund requests require a receipt.
Cedar shipping takes five business days. Cedar delivery tracking is sent by email.
Nimbus passwords must contain at least 14 characters. Nimbus password resets use a verified email link.
Atlas backups run every night at 02:00 UTC. Atlas backup snapshots are retained for seven days.
Vega support is available Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC. Vega support tickets are submitted through the help portal.
Lumen audit logs are retained for 90 days. Lumen audit log export requires administrator approval.
Comet expense claims must be submitted within 14 days. Comet expense claims above 200 pounds need manager approval.
Juniper training occurs on the first Tuesday each month. Juniper training registration closes two days before the session.
Polaris access tokens expire after 60 minutes. Polaris access tokens can be renewed using a refresh token.
Willow maintenance is scheduled on Sunday at 01:00 UTC. Willow maintenance lasts two hours.
Aspen storage includes 10 gigabytes per account. Aspen storage upgrades require a paid subscription.
Solstice cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing month. Solstice cancellation is available from account settings.
